name: Creamy Cajun Chicken with Bell Pepper & Kale Sauté

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ bunches kale
3 red bell peppers
3 green bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Working in batches if necessary, add chicken to the pot and pan-fry, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
While the chicken cooks, using a clean cutting board, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a medium bowl; set aside.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips.
Once the chicken is done, remove to a large plate and cover with foil. Return the pot to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add peppers to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, broth, and spices to the pot. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp paprika
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp cayenne pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp thyme, dried

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Once simmering, reduce heat to medium. Add cream cheese, a few pieces at a time, and stir until melted and combined, 3-4 minutes.
Add kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Return chicken to the pot and turn to coat in the sauce. Continue to cook, until heated through, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates. Enjoy!
